in_hebrew.name: ארלואין
in_hebrew.meaning: אל רוחני, מעוז אלוהים, אור אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ארלואין הוא שם שמשמעותו 'אל רוחני, מעוז אלוהים, אור אלוהים'. השם ארלואין מורכב משורשים עבריים שונים, המעידים על קשר רוחני וחזק עם האלוהים. השם נושא משמעות עמוקה של הגנה ואור אלוהי.

in_greek.name: Αρλουέν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αρλουέν σημαίνει 'Θεοσφόρος, Κράτος Θεού, Φως Θεού'. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος συνδέεται με τις ελληνικές λέξεις που αναφέρονται στη δύναμη και το φως του Θεού. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει τη σχέση του ανθρώπου με το θείο.

in_latin.name: Arluene
in_latin.meaning: Dei Fortitudo, Lux Dei, Spiritus Dei
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Arluene significat 'Dei Fortitudo, Lux Dei, Spiritus Dei'. Etymologia nominis radix habet in vocibus Latinis quae referuntur ad Dei virtutem et lucem. In traditione christiana, nomen hoc exprimit tutelam et illuminationem divinam.

The etymology of Arluene suggests a strong connection to divine protection and illumination. Historically, names with similar roots have been used in Christian tradition to signify faith and spiritual resilience. The name Arluene conveys a sense of divine support and guidance.

data.cultural_impact: Arluene carries the legacy of Anglo-Saxon and medieval European cultural symbolism of strong, courageous leadership and noble stature. Named after the fierce eagle and mighty lion, Arluene was a name revered by Christian saints and noblewomen as a symbol of unwavering strength, unyielding resilience, and unbreakable spirit. It was often given to girls born into noble or warrior families to inspire them to fulfill their destinies.
data.spiritual_significance: Arluene carries the blessings of the Christian faith, as a symbol of divine protection, grace, and power. The name was popularized by Christian saints, theologians, and families as a reminder of God's presence, strength, and love. It was believed that those bearing the name Arluene would be guided and inspired by the divine strength and courage of the Christian faith, helping them to face life's challenges with faith and resilience.
